species.name: Felbat
species.flavor: Felbats or fel bats are a race of winged, gargoyle-like demons. The Burning Legion breeds them as flying mounts for their soldiers, but many felbats have also been enslaved by the Illidari as mounts.

species.name: Corruptor
species.flavor: Corruptors are grells found in the Wicked Grotto wing of Maraudon.

species.name: Granite Golem
species.flavor: Granite Golems are golem creeps that can be encountered in many tilesets. They are one of the most powerful golem creeps.
